issue.title: Record the published-history base for verified snapshots
issue.description: Add a new decisions-web strand explaining the verified snapshot durability boundary selected in plan:202610/thin_verified_snapshots.md. State that snapshots store and cap only objects beyond remote-tracking history, name the rejected self-contained full-tree pack and larger-cap alternatives, describe that restore depends on the recorded remote retaining boundary commits, and reopen if those commits are stranded in practice. Republish with sase memory init after explicit authorization.

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Add a decisions-web strand stating that a verified snapshot stores and caps only objects not reachable from remote-tracking refs. Explain why a full self-contained tree pack or a larger cap was rejected, the cost that restore depends on the recorded remote retaining base commits, and reopen the decision if base commits are stranded in practice; run sase memory init after authorization.

issue.creation_reason: The approved plan auto-declined this unrequested decisions-web record without human review, so the skipped change needs human triage. The implementation makes the base boundary and remote-retention tradeoff concrete.

evidence.note: The approved implementation of plan:202610/thin_verified_snapshots.md confirms the deferred decision has a concrete contract: published-base packs store only unpublished objects and restore depends on remotes retaining boundary commits. The plan's auto-decision still prohibits editing memory, so this needs human triage as a separate memory task.
